41: ANÍSYA. Want to frighten me! I'm not afraid of you!
39: NIKÍTA [ holding her back ] Anísya, you seem to have forgotten!
37: ANÍSYA [ throwing herself on Akoulína ] You're raving!
36: AKOULÍNA. And you did yours to death!
34: ANÍSYA. You're a slut who goes with another's husband!
32: AKOULÍNA. I know something about you!
30: ANÍSYA. Knows what? Out with it, out with it! What do they know?
28: AKOULÍNA. Comes shoving herself in! You ought to keep quiet and remember your doings! You think no one knows!
27: NIKÍTA. Now then, now then, you women. Have done now! [ Steps between them ].
26: AKOULÍNA. Shove me? You try! [ Presses against Anísya ].
25: ANÍSYA. What are you shoving for? I'll teach you to shove!
23: AKOULÍNA. Yours indeed? No fear! You wished to steal it, but it did not come off! Get out of the way! [ Pushes her while trying to pass ].
22: ANÍSYA. Enough of your humbug. I'm not afraid of you. Whose money are you spreeing on and buying your fat wench presents with? Mine!
20: NIKÍTA. You think I have forgotten you? Look here! [ Shows her a parcel and sits down on it ] It's a present for you. Only you must earn it! Wife, where am I sitting?
19: ANÍSYA. Why am I to look?
16: AKOULÍNA. What are you pitching things down for? You pitch your own things about! [ Picks up the shawl ].
14: ANÍSYA. What am I to look at? Have I never seen anything? Put it away! [ Sweeps the shawl on to the floor with her arm ].
12: ANÍSYA. Drat you, littering the table!
11: Anísya passes angrily into the closet, returns with a tablecloth and the chimney of the samovár, and goes up to the table.
8: NAN. The print is fine! Mary has a dress like it, only lighter on a blue ground. This is pretty.
6: AKOULÍNA. Stepanída's? What's Stepanída's compared to this? [ Brightening up and undoing the parcels ] Just look here,—see the quality! It's a French one.
4: NAN. Oh how lovely! It's as good as Stepanída's.
2: AKOULÍNA [ gets out the parcels and puts them on the table ] Well, there you are,—what's the good of looking at 'em?
0: AKÍM. Oh, oh! It's sickening! [ Climbs on the oven ].
